old_source: What a drag on the chosen plane draws. Every one of these is extended along the plane's own axis when the gate is made, so the drawing gesture stays flat and the gate is solid.
current_source: What a drag in Draw mode makes. Lasso and Rectangle through view work at any angle: turn the volume until the population stands apart, draw around it, and the gate keeps every object whose position on that view falls inside the outline. Box, oval, circle and polygon are drawn on the chosen plane and given a depth with a second drag. A right-button drag always turns the volume.
